newsitem.title: USA: Kentucky to temporarily shut operations.
newsitem.headline: Kentucky to temporarily shut operations.

text.p: Kentucky Electric Steel Inc said Thursday its melting and casting operations will be shut down for about eight days in December or early January to upgrade a second strand on the caster.

Although the shutdown of the melt shop will hurt Kentucky Electric's near term earnings, the company said the addition of a second wide strand will help solve some of its recent productivity problems.
"Also, in the long run, it will help facilitate our market entry into the new thicker, wider products," said Kentucky Electric Chief Executive Charles Hanebuth.
The company did not comment on how much the shutdown would hurt earnings.
